summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting monthly progress of its Japanese statutory share repurchase program. During July 2026, it repurchased 3,845,100 common shares for ¥31,812,948,300. Under board resolutions dated May 15 and July 30, 2026, it may repurchase up to 35 million shares (1.4% of outstanding) for up to ¥200 billion through September 30, 2026, using a trust-market purchase method. As of July 31, 2026, cumulative repurchases were 9,147,800 shares for ¥71,386,599,400. This is an issuer capital return, not a tender offer; watch for continued monthly buyback progress versus authorized limits.
